name: Evil Twin
ability: You & an opposing player know each other. If the good player is executed, evil wins. Good can't win if you both live.
designRole: Two players know opposing-alignment counterparts; executing the good twin loses and blocks normal good victory while both live.
explanation: Two players know opposing-alignment counterparts; executing the good twin loses and blocks normal good victory while both live.

nightInstructions.firstNight: Wake both twins. Allow eye contact. Show the good twin's character token to the Evil Twin & vice versa.

jinxes.reason: If the Storyteller would gain the Evil Twin ability, a player becomes the Evil Twin.
